cards.card_text: "Blessed are the poor in spirit, for theirs is the kingdom of heaven."
cards.verse_text: “Blessed are the poor in spirit, for theirs is the kingdom of heaven.

cards.card_text: Jesus' first two lines about the poor in spirit and those who mourn are built the same way.
cards.verse_text: “Blessed are the poor in spirit, for theirs is the kingdom of heaven. Blessed are those who mourn, for they will be comforted.

cards.card_text: Jesus promises those persecuted because of righteousness the same thing He promised the poor in spirit.
cards.verse_text: “Blessed are the poor in spirit, for theirs is the kingdom of heaven. Blessed are those who are persecuted because of righteousness, for theirs is the kingdom of heaven.
